review.official:
Deepcolor's origin is shrouded in mystery, with large gaps in her background missing. She is remarkably gifted in the use of
Originium
abilities,
Arts
support and combat coordination.
Deepcolor is currently a special ops
Operator
for
Rhodes Island
.

files.description:
Imaging tests on this Operator show clear outlines of internal organs, with no abnormal dark spots or shadows. No unusual traces of Originium particles present in the circulatory system, no signs of infection, confirming this operator as uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
Operator Deepcolor showed no symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.17u/L 
According to Deepcolor's own statements, she often uses enriched Originium in the color palette of her paintings. As such, she has far more contact with Originium than most other Operators.

Operator Deepcolor was born to an upper middle class family in Columbia, where her father was a professor of oil painting at the Schumann Art Institute of Leithanien. Through her father, she had access to all the greatest art salons, and was profoundly influenced by the scene from a very young age. Enamored of oil painting, she resolved to become an artist. Under the guidance of her father, Deepcolor quickly showed a tremendous talent for painting and she began her art studies and easily earned the grades to be accepted into Thyssen University, where she attracted the attention of a certain advanced Originium institute in Victoria, leading her to triple-major in Originium control. After graduation, she received an offer from the Harmenszoon Design Studio and worked there for almost three years. 
Note: All of the above was provided by Deepcolor herself. Intelligence gathered from informants and confidential reports have revealed several inconsistencies in her account. It is advised to approach all background information provided by this Operator with skepticism.

Operator Deepcolor is versed in different forms of art, though she is unable to utilize it in her role as an Operator. That is of course, except in her spare time, when she sketches quick portraits for her teammates. It has been confirmed that Deepcolor has a photographic memory of the appearance and detailed features of every Operator she has ever met. Through simple observation, she derives a complete picture of their bodies and even minute imperfections that the Operators themselves are not aware of. By further analyzing these data, Deepcolor can summarize her subjects' private information that most intelligence operatives would need long periods of observation to acquire, such as lifestyle choices and daily habits. 
According to Deepcolor's personal account, this is nothing but a basic skill possessed by all painters, and she is still at the shoal of the sea of art.
Note 1: The sea she describes and the 'Deep' in her code name are strange concepts for some Operators. Please see it as 'boundless water.'
Note 2: After rejecting Deepcolor's request to paint a portrait of the creator of this file, the profiler still received a sketch from her.

Operator Deepcolor's Originium Arts remain poorly understood, which is also a key reason why Rhodes Island recruited her. 
The best guess at present is that Deepcolor's paintbrush acts as a wand or staff to other Casters, through which she channels her powers. Her combat style isn't exactly orthodox--air-painting is not a known Art casting method, nor is it easy to comprehend. 
Furthermore, perhaps most difficult to understand are the creatures she commands, dubbed 'helpers' (or 'tentacles' by nosy Operators). The reason these long, thin threads are called 'creatures' is because they possess the intelligence and mobility of a pet trained to follow orders, greatly adding to Deepcolor's combat flexibility. After comparisons to the 'Meeboos' created by Mayer of Rhine Lab, these creatures are actually mechanical entities defying any existing classification. They have spindly bodies without noses, mouths, or ears. 
According to Deepcolor's own reports, these creatures were captured by her father somewhere in faraway Sargon as a gift to her. She summed up the 'helpers' as merely 'as yet unclassified creatures.'

One of Deepcolor's recent pieces: 
Something no one would term tangible or structural, merely a pattern of different colors and layers on canvas. It forces onlookers to fixate only on the art, while comprehending a message conveyed by the rich, bright colors. 
Prolonged staring generates unusual anxiety and a strong attraction to the artwork.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Good morning, Doctor. Can I paint a portrait of you? And don't worry, I'll try not to... bring it to life. Besides, it's not like I can bring everything to life, you know.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Maybe I wasn't supposed to appear here?…

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor... what color are you, reflected in my eyes?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: There are lots of fun, creative things here at Rhodes Island. I'm feeling inspired…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: See my lovely 'assistants'? Hehe… What? You think they're scary? But, but they're so cute!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Heh, so these are the colors of your soul…? Alright then, look at me. And paint me in those colors, your colors.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: That's right. Even if no one understands me, I'll keep making art. No matter what kinds of monsters my works might become…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: We artists are a unique breed… We spend at least thirty days a month stuck in a rut, thinking all our work is trash. And we only make any progress when inspiration strikes after midnight.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: In the end, the mottled world sleeps peacefully in the dark depths—Yes, that's the true color of the ocean. Black is the only color you see? Looks like I still have more to share with you…

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Are you... dreaming? Is the world in your dreams as colorful as the beings of this world, Doctor…?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Deepcolor, a painter. Yes, just a 'painter', nothing more.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: What's this unsettling feeling...?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Um, could you just... stop caring about me? If you keep treating me so well... I-I don't know what I might become…

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you, Doctor. Now, let's complete this work of art, shall we?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: You're sending me to fight? Seriously?!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I can't lead so many people.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Do your best, everyone!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Is that who we're fighting?!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Me?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What do I do?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Scumble-scumble...

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Aww, I just need a minute!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: No need to rush.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Let's take it slow.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You'll have to get past my 'assistants' first.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Can you defeat my little ones?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: If you really make me mad... you won't like what happens next.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Let me sketch these triumphant heroes.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Aw, got my clothes dirty again...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: If only battles were like sketches. I'd just erase that one and redo it…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This room's got a nice design.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, since we happen to have some time off, want to see my latest work?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. What colors do I see for the coming year? Hm… the aroma of food, smiling operators, and presents full of kindness… a warm, tender turmeric? It's like nothing I've ever felt. I have to get this onto a canvas.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here's a hand-drawn birthday card. Do you like it? Heheh. I have two birthdays myself, in a way. I achieved a new form, after accepting the gift. Here, Doctor, look—I created this color, but it is entirely yours.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: What day is it? Oh, of course. I see my 'assistants' are all joining in on the fun. Alright, why don't we let them make an even more beautiful piece for Rhodes Island?
